text: Before a single AWS resource exists, we plan exactly how Terraform is going to build it.
Five modules, one per service boundary -- S3, Kinesis, Lambda, Glue, Redshift -- wired together from one root module per environment.
State lives remotely in S3 with a DynamoDB lock table, so two people running Terraform at the same time can't corrupt each other's work.
Every pull request runs terraform plan in CI; nothing auto-applies. A human reviews the actual plan before anything real changes, and every resource name is locked now.
The build process is planned. Next: sizing the Kinesis and Lambda ingestion path against Caldera's real telemetry volume.
